question: List the people who viewed an offer today but haven't booked anything today.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN views v ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE DATE(v.created_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings b WHERE b.requester_id = u.id AND DATE(b.created_at) = CURRENT_DATE);
